title: Can You Add Two Functions? Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
At the canteen, tea costs 15x and samosas cost 20x for x friends. Diya does not add the bill friend by friend: she adds the two rules once and gets 35x. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 2, Relations and Functions, algebra of real functions) we learn to combine two functions into a new one.

You will watch f(x) = x squared and g(x) = 2x + 1 stack their heights live to draw f + g, then meet the five NCERT ways to combine functions (sum, difference, scalar multiple, product and quotient) with every rule tried at x = 2. We compare the product and the quotient side by side and see why f/g breaks wherever g(x) = 0. A short extension for JEE compares functions: when are two functions equal? Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with root x and x, the exam trap about the domain of a sum, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 A canteen bill adds two rules
0:28 Live: the sum of two functions
0:57 Five ways to combine functions
1:35 Product vs quotient: never divide by zero
2:14 Equal functions (beyond NCERT, for JEE)
2:54 Worked example: root x and x
3:30 Exam trap: the domain of f + g
3:51 Where it is asked
3:59 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:33 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 24): Degree and Radian Measures. Why measure a turn of a bicycle wheel by the distance it rolls?
